Most of what I make is not a paper. Devices, tasks and analysis pipelines are

:::

## Force-matching device {.k-head}

::: {.entry}
::: {.meta}
Hardware &middot; built for the thesis protocol
:::
:::

A two-channel force transducer rig for the force-matching task, designed and
machined in-house with a mechanical engineer, with its own acquisition
software and calibration routine. Built because commercial equivalents cost
more than the grant and could not be modified.

*Calibration data and build notes to follow.*
